name.description: The name of this form.  Helps handlers identify form submissions.

disabled.description: A boolean property that when true, disables all inputs and actions of the form.

readOnly.description: A boolean property that when true, sets all inputs of the form to read-only. Read-only inputs are still focusable, whereas disabled inputs are not. Applicable only to text inputs.

align.description: Short for the “align-items” flex property. Specifies how rows are aligned horizontally within this column. Inherited by all "items" of this column.

justify.description: Short for the “justify-content” flex property. Specifies how rows are aligned vertically with this column. Inherited by all "items" of this column.

items.description: An array of column configuration objects.

justify.description: Short for the “justify-content” flex property. Specifies how rows are aligned vertically with this column. Overrides the value inherited from the parent column configuration.

visible.description: A boolean value that when false will not display this column.

align.description: Short for the “align-items” flex property. Specifies how widgets are aligned horizontally within this row. Inherited by all "items" of this row.

justify.description: Short for the “justify-content” flex property. Specifies how widgets are aligned vertically with this row. Inherited by all "items" of this row.

items.description: An array of row objects that exist within this column.

align.description: Short for the “align-items” flex property. Specifies how widgets are aligned horizontally within this row. Overrides the value inherited from the parent row configuration.

justify.description: Short for the “justify-content” flex property. Specifies how widgets are aligned vertically with this row. Overrides the value inherited from the parent row configuration.

visible.description: A boolean value that when false will not display this row.

enabled.description: A boolean value that when false, disables all widgets belonging to this row.

widgets.description: An array of widget objects that exist within this row.

id.description: A unique identifier used when collecting form-data. Required.

options.description: Configuration objects for each radio option.

text.description: Label text to pair with this radio.

value.description: The unique value of the radio to be evaluated when selected. Required.

layout.description: The orientation or flex direction of radios.

justify.description: Justify radios along the main axis. Horizontal if orientation is set to row, vertical if orientation is set to column.

checkbox.description: Relevant only when the type is “checkbox”.

type.description: The checkbox data type. If “boolean”, than the functionality matches the stand-alone Checkbox Component in that the value represents a bit that is either on (checked), off (not checked), or indeterminate.

options.description: Configuration objects for each checkbox option. If checkbox “type” is “string,” “value” is required.

text.description: Label text to pair with this checkbox.

value.description: The unique value of the checkbox to be evaluated when selected. Relevant (and required) only when the type is “string”.

triState.description: Whether checkbox supports a third state of 'indeterminate' - effectively 'null' or 'no choice'. Relevant only when the type is “boolean”.

layout.description: The orientation or flex direction of checkboxes.

align.description: Align checkboxes along the cross axis. Vertical if orientation is set to row, horizontal if orientation is set to column.

justify.description: Justify checkboxes along the main axis. Horizontal if orientation is set to row, vertical if orientation is set to column.

textPosition.description: Where to place label text in relation to checkbox.

indeterminateIcon.description: Icon to show when in indeterminate or tristate.

toggle.description: Relevant only when the type is toggle.

type.description: The toggle switch data type. If “boolean”, than the functionality matches the stand-alone ToggleSwitch Component in that the value represents a bit that is either on (checked) or off (not checked).

options.description: Configuration objects for each toggle switch option. If toggle switch “type” is “string,” “value” is required.

text.description: Label text to pair with this toggle switch.

value.description: The unique value of the toggle switch to be evaluated when selected. Relevant (and required) only when the type is “string”.

layout.description: The orientation or flex direction of toggle switches.

align.description: Align toggle switches along the cross axis. Vertical if orientation is set to row, horizontal if orientation is set to column.

justify.description: Justify toggle switches along the main axis. Horizontal if orientation is set to row, vertical if orientation is set to column.

textPosition.description: Where to place label text in relation to toggle switch.

selected.description: Color of the slider when the toggle switch is selected.

unselected.description: Color of the slider when the toggle switch is not selected.

show.description: Whether to display labels at periodic values along track

interval.description: Interval at which to display periodic labels along track

step.description: Intervals along track at which value may be set

dropdown.description: Relevant only when the type is “dropdown”.

value.description: Actual value to be matched by input/selection

label.description: Text to display in menu representing this option

isDisabled.description: Whether this option is currently disabled from selection

options.description: Configuration objects for each dropdown option. At minimum, 'value' and 'label' are required for each.

wrapMultiSelectValues.description: Wrap values when true, display values on one line when false. Relevant only when 'multiSelect' is enabled.

text.description: Prompt text to display when no options are selected

enabled.description: Whether options are searchable by typing text into the field

matching.description: Whether search string must match from the start or may match any position of an option

noResultsText.description: Text to display in dropdown when no options match search

searchParam.description: Read-only (output). The current search text, written to this property by the component (debounced) as the user types so scripts/bindings can observe it. The component owns this value; binding it as an input has no effect and will be overwritten.

showClearIcon.description: Whether to render a button allowing user to clear the selection

allowCustomOptions.description: Whether user may enter a custom value to be submitted

textAlign.description: Aligns the value(s) and/or placeholder text displayed within the dropdown

minMenuHeight.description: This is the required minimum allowable height of the menu before it attempts to flip or switch its placement (below/above).

maxMenuHeight.description: Maximum height of the dropdown menu before it becomes scrollable.

message.description: Validation message configuration by associated violation. If unconfigured, browser defaults will be utilized.

date-picker.description: Relevant only when the type is “date-picker”.

defaultToNow.description: Default value of field is set to the date of when the view is opened.

displayType.description: Display this widget as a standard input (picker displayed in a modal) vs. the picker displayed inline.

minDate.description: Minimum date/time as a Date object or timestamp in milliseconds. If null, the minimum date is 10 years in the past from today.

maxDate.description: Maximum date/time as a Date object or timestamp in milliseconds. If null, the maximum date is 10 years in the future from today.

format.description: Template for formatting date display - must be valid moment.js format, e.g. 'MM/DD/YYYY'

placeholder.description: Text for input field to display when no date/time is selected. Only relevant with 'displayType' of 'input.'

locale.description: Code for localization of language and formatting

dismissOnSelect.description: Determines if the date picker should be dismissed when a date is selected. Only relevant with 'displayType' of 'input.'

defaultToNow.description: Default value of field is set to the time of when the view is opened.

minTime.description: Minimum time configured by hours (24 hour format), minutes, and seconds.

maxTime.description: Maximum time configured by hours (24 hour format), minutes, and seconds.

format.description: Template for formatting time display - must be valid moment.js format, e.g. 'h:mm a'

locale.description: Code for localization of language and formatting

minDate.description: Minimum date/time as a Date object or timestamp in milliseconds. If null, the minimum date is 10 years in the past from today.

maxDate.description: Maximum date/time as a Date object or timestamp in milliseconds. If null, the maximum date is 10 years in the future from today.

format.description: Template for formatting date display - must be valid moment.js format, e.g. 'MM/DD/YYYY h:mm a'

placeholder.description: Text for input field to display when no date/time is selected. Only relevant with 'displayType' of 'input.'

locale.description: Code for localization of language and formatting

file-upload.description: Relevant only when the type is “file-upload”.

animate.description: If enabled, animates adding/removing files from the file upload list. Defaults to true.

fileSizeLimit.description: The maximum file size in MB (per file) that a user can upload. Please note that there is also a server-side limit capping this value (view the max-file-size property within the web.xml file). Custom associated violation: fileSizeLimit.

value.description: The maximum file size in MB (per file). Defaults to 10 MB.

maxUploads.description: The maximum amount of simultaneous uploads. Custom associated violation: maxUploads.

value.description: An integer for the maximum amount of simultaneous uploads. Defaults to 5.

supportedFileTypes.description: A list of unique file type specifiers that the control will allow. If nothing is specified, all file types are allowed. Custom associated violation: supportedFileTypes.

value.description: A list of unique file type specifiers.

message.description: Validation message configuration by associated violation. If unconfigured, browser or custom defaults will be utilized.

visible.description: A boolean value that when false, will remove this widget from the row.

enabled.description: A boolean value that when false, disables this widget.

readOnly.description: A boolean value that when true, sets this widget to read-only. Read-only inputs are still focusable, whereas disabled inputs are not. Applicable only to text-based inputs.

defaultValue.description: The default value of this form field that is used as the value when the form is reset.

layout.description: Specifies how the contents of the widget are arranged.

label.description: Configuration object for the widget’s label.

style.description: A general style object containing inline styles and CSS class names to apply to this label.

info.description: Configuration object for the widget’s info indicator.

type.description: Display type for this info indicator. Possible values are: caption, tooltip. Caption is displayed as subtext under label.

style.description: A general style object containing inline styles and CSS class names to apply to this info indicator.

tabIndex.description: A number value indicating that an element can be focused, and the order in which it participates in keyboard navigation (usually with the tab key).

style.description: A general style object containing inline styles and CSS class names to apply to this widget.
A general object, specifying any inline styles and CSS class names, that will be applied to this row. Additional flex properties can be introduced here.

visibleWhen.description: An object containing a widget id and value to match. When the value of the widget matches, this row is shown. Will automatically write to the visible property.

enabledWhen.description: An object containing a widget id and a value to match. When the value of the widget matches, all of this row’s widgets become enabled. Will automatically write to the enabled property.

style.description: A general object, specifying any inline styles and CSS class names, that is inherited by all "items" of this row. Additional flex properties can be introduced here.

A general object, specifying any inline styles and CSS class names, that if defined will merge with the style object inherited from the parent configuration. Additional flex properties can be introduced here.
A general object, specifying any inline styles and CSS class names, that is inherited by all "items" of this column. Additional flex properties can be introduced here.

actions.description: Configuration object for this form’s cancel and submit actions.

disabled.description: A boolean value that when true will disable and hide the action bar.

fixed.description: A boolean value that when true will fix the form action bar so that it is always visible.

layout.description: Specifies how the contents of the action bar are arranged.

align.description: Align actions along the cross axis. Vertical if orientation is set to row, horizontal if orientation is set to column.

justify.description: Justify actions along the main axis. Horizontal if orientation is set to row, vertical if orientation is set to column.

disabled.description: A boolean defining the enabled (clickable) state of the submit button.

domID.description: A unique identifier for automated testing.

fireComponentEvent.description: A boolean indicating if the onSubmitActionPerformed component event should be fired as a result of pressing the submit button.

fireSubmissionEvent.description: A boolean indicating if the form data should proceed through the submission process.

submissionHandler.description: The name of the receiving submission handler script.

includeDisabledFieldValues.description: A boolean indicating if the values of disabled fields should be included in the form submission data.

includeHiddenFieldValues.description: A boolean indicating if the values of hidden fields should be included in the form submission data.

autoDisable.description: Automatically writes either true or false to the enabled property depending on the validity state of the form, or its submission state, i.e. if the form is awaiting a submission response.

resetOn.description: An enum string consisting of the options “success” and “action”. If set to “success”, will reset the form data to its defaults if the form receives a success response. If set to “action”, will reset the form data to its defaults immediately after the submit action (submit is clicked).

awaitResponse.description: If enabled, will let the form know that it should wait for a response, which may be an error, partial success, or success. Only relevant when 'fireSubmissionEvent' is enabled.

responseDisplay.description: Configuration for the inline display of the form submission response notification. Only utilized when submit is configured to wait for a response (i.e. both fireSubmissionEvent and awaitResponse are 'true').

layout.description: Specifies how the container of the response is arranged in relation to the actions.

titleStyle.description: A general style object containing inline styles and CSS class names to apply to the response title.

messageStyle.description: A general style object containing inline styles and CSS class names to apply to the response message.

style.description: A general style object containing inline styles and CSS class names to apply to the inline response notification container.
Button style configuration object.

disabled.description: A boolean defining the enabled (clickable) state of the cancel button.

domID.description: A unique identifier for automated testing.

fireComponentEvent.description: A boolean indicating if the onCancelActionPerformed component event should be fired as a result of pressing the cancel button.

reset.description: A boolean defining whether the form data should immediately be reset as a result of pressing the cancel button.

style.description: Button style configuration object.
A general style object containing inline styles and CSS class names to apply to the action bar.

context.description: A context object that provides additional information beyond the forms data. This context object is present in action events.

data.description: A collection of this form’s input values, keyed on the id defined in widget configurations. Form data is present in action events. Can be written to in order to pre-populate inputs.

validation.description: An object containing information regarding the live validity of this form’s input values, and the inputs that are in violation. Also contains a read-only boolean property that is true when this form is in an invalid state. Read-only.

style.description: A general object, specifying any inline styles and CSS class names, that will be applied to this form.

autoComplete.description: Specifies what if any permission the user agent has to provide automated assistance in filling out form field values, as well as guidance to the browser as to the type of information expected in the field.

path.description: Shorthand path to icon source, in format: library/iconName

library.description: Optional alternative to 'path', name of library where icon is located. Must also supply 'name'.

name.description: Optional alternative to 'path', name of icon. Must also supply 'library'.

enabled.description: Color of the icon when enabled. Can be a named color.

disabled.description: Color of the icon when disabled. Can be a named color.

placeholder.description: Text displayed when value is empty

location.description: The preferred opening direction of the tooltip in relation to the icon. Possible values are: above, below, left, right.

pixelOffset.description: The offset, in pixels, of the tooltip from the icon's center position.

tail.description: Enables a decorative triangle on the tooltip that points to the icon.

style.description: A general style object containing inline styles and CSS class names to apply to the content of this tooltip. Note: margins are not applied. To move tooltip in relation to the icon, utilize the pixelOffset property.

validationConstraintMax.description: Max constraint configuration. The value must be less than or equal to the value. Associated violation: rangeOverflow.

value.description: A valid number, date, or date and time.

validationConstraintMin.description: Min constraint configuration. The value must be greater than or equal to the value. Associated violation: rangeUnderflow.

value.description: A valid number, date, or date and time.

validationConstraintMaxLength.description: Maxlength constraint configuration. The number of characters (code points) must not exceed the value of the attribute. Associated violation: tooLong.

validationConstraintMinLength.description: Minlength constraint configuration. The number of characters (code points) must not be less than the value of the attribute, if non-empty. Associated violation: tooShort.

validationConstraintPattern.description: Pattern constraint configuration. The value must match this pattern. Associated violation: patternMismatch.

value.description: A regular expression (compiled with the global, ignoreCase, and multiline flags disabled).

validationConstraintRequired.description: Required constraint configuration. There must be a value (if set). Associated violation: valueMissing.

validationConstraintStep.description: Step constraint configuration. Unless the step is set to the "any" literal, the value must be min + an integral multiple of the step. Associated violation: stepMismatch.

value.description: An integer (ex: number of days, number of months, number of weeks, number of seconds).

validationMessage.description: Validation error message. Optional. Default value is the browser's default validation message.

validity.description: The current validity state of the form control.

events.name: onChange
events.description: An event that fires whenever the value of form control's input changes. The change event contains the input's value and its identifying key. If the input handles file data, file data will be provided. Useful for performing custom validation.

schema.description: An object describing the input change event.

files.description: A list of the input's files (provided if the input handles file data such as the file upload widget). Each file is a unique object consisting of the following properties: contentType, name, and size. Access file byte data by calling getBytes() on each object in the list.

contentType.description: The content type of the file.

size.description: The size (in bytes) of the file that was uploaded.

events.name: onSuccess
events.description: An event that fires under conditions where the form is configured to use the form submission event, configured to wait for a response, and the response returned from the handler is considered a success (put in queue while offline, or fully handled by session event). Contains the success response object.

events.name: onError
events.description: An event that fires under conditions where the form is configured to use the form submission event, configured to wait for a response, and the response returned from the handler is considered an error (handled by session event, or no handler found). Contains the full error response.

events.name: onCancelActionPerformed
events.description: A component event that is fired, if configured, when the form’s cancel action is effectively clicked. The action event includes the form data object.

events.name: onSubmitActionPerformed
events.description: A component event that is fired, if configured, when the form's submit action is effectively clicked. The action event includes the form data object. If the submission contains file data, file data will be provided under files while the form data will be under data.

schema.description: The form data object and uploaded file assets.
